description: Formas GTFS_shapes is a dataset listed in Dades Obertes FGC open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya (FGC). Las formas describen la ruta física que realiza un vehículo y vienen definidas en el archivo shapes.txt (formato GTFS). Las formas se asocian con viajes individuales y se componen de una secuencia de puntos. El trazado ordenado de los puntos proporciona la ruta del vehículo. Coverage: Catalonia (Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya network). The portal files it under Infraestructuras y estaciones, Turismo. Its keywords are gtfs, formas, shapes, puntos, rutas. The portal shows 11,662 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0 (cc-by 4.0) (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-dadesobertes-fgc-cat-portal.
